annotations.title: Show the HTMLRadar plan and free links used

description: Reports which HTMLRadar account the API key belongs to (its email address), the plan it is on and how many of its free tracked links it has used out of the free allowance, or that tracked links are unlimited. It also reports what this connection may do (read only, or read and publish), any notice about the plan, and any notice about a newer version of the HTMLRadar package.
name: whoami
